name: slowboard
description: Slowboard as you: every organisation you belong to, its boards, conversations and files.
long_description: With your key, Claude reads and writes Slowboard as you -- discussions, replies, canvases, kanbans, conversations, action points, decisions and files -- in every organisation you belong to, under the same rules as on screen. One key covers them all and follows your access as it changes.

key.title: Your key
key.description: Made on the board under Settings > You > API keys. Allow writing to post, edit and draw.
